title: Choosing an entrance that suits the shop
target: How to change the front of a Supermarket Simulator shop, using the entrance variants, the overlay and the name sign the game provides.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop you are allowed to change

steps.do: Decide on the entrance before spending on decoration behind it.
steps.because: the entrance is a system with a manager of its own (EntranceManager)

steps.do: Look at the variants rather than settling for the first front you were given.
steps.because: the game keeps a holder and signboards for entrance variants (EntranceVariantHolder)

steps.do: Change it through the overlay rather than expecting it to swap on its own.
steps.because: there is an overlay and a change item for it (EntranceChangeOverlay)

steps.do: Set the name sign in the same visit, since it sits on the entrance.
steps.because: the entrance name has its own setter (EntranceNameSignSetter)

steps.do: Leave the doorway clear after rearranging the front.
steps.because: the entrance is built from its own brick, wall and trim pieces (T_StoreEntrance_Wall_AlbedoTransparency)

commonMistakes: Decorating the inside and never touching the front.
Changing the entrance and forgetting the name sign.
Blocking the doorway after rearranging the front.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
